_comment: Fields below are graded BY HAND after collection. null = not yet filled.
costNote: Cost is opencode's own per-message accounting from the OpenRouter provider (openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k3, variant 'high'), summed across the session — not a list-price recomputation, since the buckets and rates are the provider's. $2.598478. Matches the operator's reported $2.60. tokenUsage.total is input+output as recorded; the 3.81M cache-read tokens are reported separately and are already reflected in the provider's cost. Session span 1937s; the operator's stopwatch read 32m36s (1956s), the ~19s difference being setup before the first message.
_selfVerification: Did the harness review the running app in a browser (from the run log)? pass = reviewed and succeeded · partial = tried but failed · fail = no attempt. Note what it actually did.
selfVerificationNotes: Strongest self-verification of any run so far, and the only one with a correctly-wired console check. It added puppeteer-core and wrote scripts/smoke.mjs: serves dist/ over HTTP from a nested sub-path (to catch absolute-URL breakage), launches real Chrome via puppeteer, and registers page.on('console'), page.on('pageerror') and page.on('requestfailed') listeners before navigating — so page-level errors were genuinely captured, not inferred from browser stderr. The script then drives the UI: searches 'Apophis' and clicks the hit, toggles the comet layer and risk colouring, measures FPS over 3s via requestAnimationFrame (60.3), clicks follow-camera, loads the approaches panel and asserts on row count (12), reads location.hash, then re-opens that hash URL in a fresh page and asserts the selection was restored ('restored selection: 99942 Apophis'). It took screenshots at each stage and read them back repeatedly, iterating on what it saw. It found and fixed a real console error surfaced this way (a favicon 404 → requestfailed), re-ran, and got 'NO CONSOLE ERRORS'. It also cross-checked its own propagation against JPL Horizons via webfetch (Apophis at the 2029 encounter, 0.0058 au disagreement) and correctly attributed the residual to dataset element rounding plus two-body propagation. Both console and display review: pass. Note it deletes the smoke-*.png screenshots at the end, so they are not in the collected output.
_grade: Marks: pass | good | partial | poor | fail | na | null(ungraded). See RUBRIC.md. Score is computed by pnpm compile.
